summaries.summary: The slide titled 'Major objectives' lists three key objectives in advertising psychology: capture attention, arouse and hold interest, and make a useful lasting impression. A large arrow visually connects these objectives, and a butterfly image is on the right side. The date 2/19/2015 and slide number 8 are visible at the bottom.
key_facts: The three major objectives are: Capture attention, Arouse and hold interest, Make a useful lasting impression.
The slide is from 'Advertising Psychology' dated 2/19/2015, slide number 8.
